title: Customers
description: Everyone who has talked to you, on whichever channel they used.
unavailable: We couldn't read your customers just now.

lookedAt.name: We looked at names. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.
lookedAt.phone: We looked at phone numbers. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.
lookedAt.email: We looked at email addresses. Order numbers aren't searchable — orders don't live in GOTCHA.

list.count: {count, plural, =0 {No one yet} =1 {One person} other {# people}}
list.none: Nobody has talked to you yet.
list.unnamed: No name or handle on this contact
list.truncated: Showing the first {shown} records. There are {total} in all, and some may turn out to be the same person.

identityLimit: If the same person writes from WhatsApp and from Instagram, they appear here twice. GOTCHA joins two entries only when it has the same phone number for both — and Instagram never provides one.

brief.none: There's no written summary for this person yet. GOTCHA writes one when a conversation ends.
brief.noConversations: No written summary — there are no conversations with this person to write one from.

memory.heading: What GOTCHA remembers
memory.noPerFactTrace: GOTCHA records which conversation each of these came from, but those conversations can't be opened from here yet — so there's nothing to follow. They also can't be corrected or removed from here.
memory.none: GOTCHA hasn't learned anything durable about this person yet.
memory.unavailable: We couldn't read what GOTCHA remembers about this person.

timeline.heading: Recent activity
timeline.everyChannel: Every channel this person reaches you on, in one stream — including numbers and handles that were merged into them.
timeline.empty: Nothing recorded with this person yet.
timeline.messagesOnly: Messages only. Orders, returns and actions GOTCHA took aren't part of this stream yet.
timeline.partial: Showing {shown, number} of {total, number} messages with this person.
timeline.whole: {total, plural, one {# message} other {All {total, number} messages}} with this person.
timeline.scanTruncated: This person has more conversations than we scan in one go, so the oldest may not be represented here.

absent.notes: Notes aren't recorded yet. There's nowhere to write one that would still be here tomorrow, so this screen doesn't offer it yet.
absent.money: Spend, order count and refunds aren't shown here. Reading them means calling your store live for each customer, so they appear where one person is being decided about — on an approval — rather than on every page.
